# Output edge captures

These fixed sources cover single-category line and area charts, zero-hanging list
markers, wave and suppressed underlines, clipped text, independently sized
connector markers, flat caps and a blank presentation at its declared size.

The captures include complete editable packages, evaluated models, text geometry
and independent native PNGs. The tests compare text positions at 1e-8 points and
pin the source, asset and artifact hashes. Native comparisons are separate from
Microsoft Word and PowerPoint review, which remains pending.
